arguments.content: The meeting reviewed the Northwind account. The client contact was John Mitchell (john.mitchell@example.com).   Client contact: John Mitchell <john.mitchell@example.com>

  1. The phase-two rollout starts on 2026-02-10.

  2. Weekly status calls move to Tuesdays at 10:00.

  3. The reporting dashboard will use the revised metric definitions.'
